products.title: Lenovo ThinkVision P27u-20
products.description: The Lenovo ThinkVision P27u-20 is a professional 27-inch 4K UHD monitor designed specifically for content creators, photographers, and graphic designers. It features a high-resolution 3840 x 2160 IPS display with factory-calibrated color accuracy, supporting 99.1% DCI-P3 and 99.5% Adobe RGB color gamuts. Certified with DisplayHDR 400, it ensures realistic brightness and contrast. The monitor is highly connected via Thunderbolt 4, offering a 'one cable' solution for 40 Gbps data speeds, 1 Gbps Ethernet, and up to 100W power delivery. It also includes built-in 3W speakers and an ergonomic stand with lift, tilt, swivel, and pivot adjustments.
